subject: [PATCH v4 2/8] mm/page_alloc: detect zonelist rebuilds from memory hot-add

2026-10-28.patch_summary: This patch detects and handles zonelist rebuilds caused by memory hot-add, which can lead to spurious allocation failures for __GFP_THISNODE callers. The issue arises when onlining a zone's first block rewrites the zonelists in place, causing concurrent allocations to skip eligible zones. To fix this, the patch gates sequence checks on CONFIG_MEMORY_HOTPLUG, covering all configurations that rebuild zonelists after boot. This change ensures that allocation failures are properly handled even in the presence of hot-add events.
